mission: Deploy a legal-focused OpenClaw agent on the workstation as immutable, generation-based, Pulumi+Effect-managed infrastructure — prototype gauntlet first, then driver, then live agent.
statusNote: P1 driver COMPLETE 2026-07-27: @beep/openclaw green under repo gates with real-pinned-binary acceptance (validate + negative fixtures + lossy schema-export guard). P0 gauntlet cleared the same week (all four spikes pass). P2 (generation engine + applicator) is unblocked.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

phases.name: Prototype gauntlet
phases.statusNote: COMPLETE 2026-07-27. All four spikes pass every contract assertion: spike 1 (6/6, writer matrix with no INCOMPATIBLE row), spike 2 (3/3), spike 3 (3/3, rotation/degraded-reload/tied probes), spike 4 (3/3). No gated decision re-opened. Evidence under history/p0/.

phases.name: Driver (@beep/openclaw)
phases.statusNote: COMPLETE 2026-07-27. packages/drivers/openclaw ships the desired-intent schema, the versioned render adapter pinned to openclaw@2026.7.1-2, the CLI wrapper (version, read-only doctor, config validate, config schema, secrets reload, gateway health, channels status, agent turn), the systemctl --user wrapper, and HTTP probes. Integration lane proves the real pinned binary accepts the rendered golden intent, rejects four negative fixtures, and exports no lossy placeholder for declared extension surfaces. Landed via the goals/openclaw-p1-driver PR.

phases.name: Generation engine + workstation applicator
phases.statusNote: UNBLOCKED 2026-07-27: P1 driver complete. Next phase to start.

phases.name: Close: Yeet PRs to mergeable + reflection
